title: Topic 3.9: Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ

pages.lesson:
LESSON: NICODEMUS’ ENCOUNTER WITH JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.9: Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how they respond to John 3:16. How did Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ change his life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ
2. discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today
3. recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NICODEMUS’ ENCOUNTER WITH JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: NICODEMUS’ ENCOUNTER WITH JESUS CHRIST
Study Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ

What this means
In this part you learn to retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life

What this means
In this part you learn to recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ in your own words. (skill: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ.
3. Practise this skill: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today.
4. Practise this skill: recite John 3:16 and believe in Jesus Christ to inherit eternal life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they respond to John 3:16. How did Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ change his life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: retell the story of Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ.
5. Be able to: discuss the importance of baptism to Christians today.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
